text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm having a meeting with Mejiro<n>Dober in my
office when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry... I just have a bit of a<n>headache. I
already took medicine for<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I said I'm fine, so... Urgh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Guess there's no hiding it...Fine. I'll take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Guess there's no hiding it...Fine. I'll take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let me rest here for a little while. I<n>don't want
everyone worrying about<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober continues to suffer<n>from her
headache for some time.
